"import math
import cadquery as cq

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# L-angle bracket with inner fillet and one through hole per leg
# All dimensions in mm (hard-coded, deterministic)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

# --- Parameters ---
LEG_X = 80.0        # horizontal leg length along +X (x: 0..80)
LEG_Z = 60.0        # vertical leg height along +Z (z: 0..60)
T = 10.0            # leg thickness (horizontal leg z: 0..10, vertical leg x: 0..10)
W = 40.0            # leg width along +Y (y: 0..40)
R_FILLET = 12.0     # inner concave fillet radius
D_HOLE = 9.0        # through-hole diameter
HOLE_X = 45.0       # horizontal-leg hole center x (axis parallel to Z)
HOLE_Y = 20.0       # both holes center y
HOLE_Z = 35.0       # vertical-leg hole center z (axis parallel to X)

# --- Fillet arc geometry in the XZ profile ---
# Arc center at (T+R, T+R) = (22, 22); tangent points (22, 10) and (10, 22).
cx = T + R_FILLET
cz = T + R_FILLET
k = R_FILLET / math.sqrt(2.0)
arc_mid = (cx - k, cz - k)  # midpoint of the concave quarter arc

# --- L-shaped profile in the XZ plane, extruded 40 mm along -Y ---
# (plane placed at y = W so the extrusion fills y = 0..40)
body = (
    cq.Workplane("XZ", origin=(0, W, 0))
    .moveTo(0, 0)                       # origin corner
    .lineTo(LEG_X, 0)                   # bottom of horizontal leg
    .lineTo(LEG_X, T)                   # outer end face of horizontal leg
    .lineTo(cx, T)                      # top of horizontal leg to fillet tangent (22, 10)
    .threePointArc(arc_mid, (T, cz))    # concave fillet to tangent (10, 22)
    .lineTo(T, LEG_Z)                   # inner face of vertical leg
    .lineTo(0, LEG_Z)                   # top of vertical leg
    .close()                            # shared back face x = 0
    .extrude(W)                         # normal is -Y -> solid spans y = 0..40
)

# --- Through holes ---
r = D_HOLE / 2.0
pad = 1.0  # overshoot so the cuts are clean through-holes

drill_horizontal = cq.Solid.makeCylinder(
    r, T + 2.0 * pad, cq.Vector(HOLE_X, HOLE_Y, -pad), cq.Vector(0, 0, 1)
)  # axis parallel to Z through the horizontal leg

drill_vertical = cq.Solid.makeCylinder(
    r, T + 2.0 * pad, cq.Vector(-pad, HOLE_Y, HOLE_Z), cq.Vector(1, 0, 0)
)  # axis parallel to X through the vertical leg

part = body.cut(drill_horizontal).cut(drill_vertical).clean()

# --- Export the single solid ---
shape = part.val()
cq.exporters.export(shape, "part.step")

# --- Verification output (deterministic) ---
print("volume = {:.6f} mm^3".format(shape.Volume()))
bb = shape.BoundingBox()
print("bbox   = {:.6f} x {:.6f} x {:.6f}".format(bb.xlen, bb.ylen, bb.zlen))
print("faces  = {}".format(len(shape.Faces())))"
